description: This Java class 'GatewayService' is the main entry point and core service class for the Eclipse Ditto Gateway service. It initializes the Gateway service, manages its configuration, and starts the main actor system for the service.

classes.name: GatewayService
classes.description: Main service class for the Eclipse Ditto Gateway, extending DittoService, responsible for initialization and startup of the Gateway actor system.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Static method that initializes and starts the GatewayService.

methods.name: getServiceSpecificConfig
methods.description: Overrides base method to provide Gateway-specific configuration.

methods.name: startDevOpsCommandsActor
methods.description: Override to start the DevOps commands actor if needed (currently empty as actor is started by GatewayRootActor).

methods.name: getMainRootActorProps
methods.description: Provides Props for the main Actor for the Gateway service.
